mobileEmulation.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU (0x00002D59) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

checks: All four wheel angles survive high/low/standard LOD swaps while paused at nonzero reference distance.
Zero motor power displays standby; stopped-engine output/fuel ratio displays unavailable.
ModeCode=4 with negative motor power displays engine charging rather than braking recovery.
Sample FuelRate_Lh and displayed L/h equal the difference of immutable saved FuelUsed_L samples divided by their time interval.
Battery dialog explains DC-bus approximation, auxiliary demand and net battery power sign.

limits: Development server on localhost; not an online deployment verification.
Short functional checks include video instrumentation; use a separate sustained run for performance conclusions.
Mobile tests emulate touch and viewport on the desktop GPU; no physical phone was measured.
The 120-second sustained replay test is explicitly excluded, not counted as skipped.
